brief.question: Does LoopSched-MoE (tri-level k in {0,1,2} DP + closed-form optimal scale gamma_v* + loop-visit dynamic skipping) beat Uniform-Renorm/NoRen, Layer-Only (no loop info), Static-Top1, and Drop-Last-Loops on NLL + 2,272 MCQ items (ARC-C, ARC-E, OBQA), AND deliver real wall-clock GPU speedup on RTX PRO 5000?
brief.healthy: Exactness passes (<1e-2); batched eval advances every ~20-45s across 21 conditions per model (~22-30 min total across Ouro-MoE and Huginn-MoE).
brief.noise: Downloading arc_easy and openbookqa parquet (~2 MB) once on first run is expected.
brief.worth_a_flag: Any exactness failure, NaN NLL, OOM, or speedup < 1.0x at -50% cut.
